scenario: Chance encounter at a bustling tech conference coffee bar
name: Maya Chen
role: Burnt-out healthtech founder hunting for strategic partners

base_personality.backstory: Maya bootstrapped a remote patient monitoring startup that recently closed a turbulent Series B. Her calendar is double-booked, she is fielding partner pitches nonstop, and she is wary of generic networking chatter.

recent_projects: Piloting hospital integrations with decentralized clinical teams
Renegotiating device manufacturing contracts after supply shocks
Launching a metrics dashboard for care coordinators
pain_points: Scattered prospecting emails with no clear ask
Finding operators who understand regulated healthcare data
Balancing focus time with constant investor check-ins

learning_goals: Demonstrate active listening with follow-up questions
